title: Correction
description: An entry in the public correction log: what was wrong, who reported it, what was done, and which claim replaced it. Append-only — a correction is never edited to hide that it happened, and never deleted. NEW FILE: the spec requires /data/corrections and a /corrections/ route, and claim.correction_id references it, but no schema was supplied.

$comment.description: Commentary on a fixture. Permitted in tests/fixtures only; validate.ts rejects this key anywhere under /data.

reported_by.description: Free text, because reporters are often external and not project handles. Use 'anonymous' rather than omitting. Never record a reporter's email, phone, or address here — rule 9 applies to this file too.

what_was_wrong.description: Plain statement of the error, in neutral terms. Rendered verbatim on /corrections/.

action.description: What was actually done. no_change_needed is a legitimate outcome and is still logged — a report that turned out to be mistaken is part of the public record.

action_note.description: Why this action, especially when the action was no_change_needed.

affected_claims.description: Every claim the report touched, whether or not it changed.

replacement_claims.description: Required when action is claim_superseded. validate.ts checks that each of these actually supersedes one of affected_claims.
